result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and subsequent certified deletion. However, it goes beyond the playbook by covering all Works and Confidential Information, not merely Customer Data. More significantly, termination of a single Statement of Work triggers return and deletion of all Company data and Confidential Information, even if the Agreement or other Statements of Work remain active; this could interfere with continuing services. The machine-readable-format requirement is also awkwardly applied to Works and all Confidential Information. The provision should be limited to data associated with the terminated arrangement and exclude materials needed for ongoing services or legally required retention.
